overview: The paper proposes QDFFDT, an offline reinforcement learning method that adaptively fuses global sequential features and local Markovian features using a learnable mechanism to improve trajectory stitching, augmented by a Q-learning module for policy improvement.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Handles the parsing and inheritance of configuration files, providing hyperparameter access for model architectures, training steps, and environment setups without hardcoding specific values.

modules.name: Data Processing and Trajectory Sampling
modules.description: Loads offline datasets, preprocesses transitions into trajectories, and constructs batch samples containing sequences of states, actions, rewards, and return-to-go for model training.

modules.name: V-Network and Alpha Network Training
modules.description: Implements the training logic for the V-network via expectile regression and the Alpha network for adaptive weight prediction, taking states and RTGs as input and outputting the fusion coefficient.

modules.name: Dual-Feature Extraction Networks
modules.description: Constructs the global feature extractor using a causal Transformer and the local feature extractor using an MLP, processing sequence tokens and single-step inputs respectively.

modules.name: Adaptive Feature Fusion Mechanism
modules.description: Applies layer normalization to the extracted global and local features and dynamically combines them using the adaptive fusion coefficient to produce the final fused representation.

modules.name: QDFFDT Policy Network
modules.description: Integrates the feature extractors, fusion module, and action head to map input trajectory sequences to predicted actions, serving as the primary policy network.

modules.name: Q-Network and Target Networks
modules.description: Builds the twin Q-network architectures and their corresponding target networks for evaluating state-action pairs and providing stable learning targets.

modules.name: Q-Value Learning Update
modules.description: Computes the Q-value loss using either 1-step or n-step Bellman equations, sampling target actions from the target policy to update the twin Q-networks.

modules.name: Policy Optimization with Q-Augmentation
modules.description: Calculates the policy loss as a weighted combination of the behavior cloning loss and the normalized Q-value maximization objective to update the policy network.

modules.name: Training Loop Controller
modules.description: Manages the overall training loop, coordinating the sequential optimization of the V-network, Alpha network, Q-networks, and policy network, including gradient clipping and target network updates.

modules.name: Inference and Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: Handles the inference process by generating candidate actions conditioned on multiple target RTGs and selecting the final action based on the maximum Q-value among the candidates.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Configures and executes ablation studies, such as replacing dynamic fusion with static weights, switching fusion mechanisms, or isolating individual feature branches.

modules.name: Visualization and Analysis Tools
modules.description: Provides utilities for logging training metrics, visualizing the relationship between the fusion coefficient and RTG distribution, and generating performance comparison charts.
